name: mcts_refine
description: Performs Monte Carlo Tree Search with PUCT and progressive widening to iteratively refine text, code, or images.

initial_file.description: Path to the artifact to refine — a file (text, markdown, code, prompt) or a directory (e.g. a multi-file project). Required: the artifact must be specified by path, not as inline text.

iterations.description: Number of MCTS iterations to execute.

objective.description: The target rubric, aesthetic goal, or refinement standard.
